about.title: Who I Am
about.heading: About me
about.intro: Hey there, I'm Mathias! Coding runs in my blood — there's something deeply satisfying about turning a blank file into something that actually works. I'm constantly looking to sharpen my skills, whether that's diving into new frameworks or solving tricky problems. My drive: setting myself up for a strong future in tech and writing code that lasts.

items.location: Based in Leipzig, Germany — but not tied to it. I'm fully open to remote work and wouldn't rule out relocating for the right opportunity.
items.mindset: I genuinely enjoy picking up new technologies — it keeps things exciting and ensures I'm always moving forward. Staying current isn't a chore for me, it's part of my mindset.
items.problem: When I hit a problem, I don't let go until it's solved. I approach challenges analytically — breaking them down, questioning my assumptions, and working through them step by step. I genuinely enjoy that process, even when it gets frustrating.

skills.title: Technologies
skills.heading: Skill Set
skills.intro: I work with the core building blocks of the web — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — and have extended that foundation with TypeScript and SCSS. My current framework focus is Angular, where I'm actively building real projects. Keeping up with the fast pace of web development isn't a burden for me, it's what keeps the work exciting.
skills.cta_text: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.intro: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

pokedex.description: Gotta catch ´em all — or at least look them up. This Pokédex pulls live data from the PokéAPI and lets you search, filter, and explore detailed cards for every Pokémon.

el_pollo_loco.description: Run, jump, throw — El Pollo Loco was my first dive into object-oriented JavaScript. Help Pepe collect coins and salsa bottles to take down the crazy hen.

tcg_vault.description: Collect, manage, dominate — TCG Vault brings Magic: The Gathering and Yu-Gi-Oh! together in one app. Browse thousands of cards via live API, manage your collection and find out which decks you can already build.

join.description: Manage tasks, coordinate teams, keep projects on track — Join brings all your project management into one clear Kanban board. Create tasks, assign them to contacts, and stay on top of every step in your workflow.

references.heading: What my colleagues say about me

jobs.text: Working with Mathias was a great experience, and I would love to team up with him again anytime. He has a helpful way of thinking along with the project and consistently shares useful, constructive feedback. Even when we had to fix things last minute, he jumped right in with a positive attitude and got it done. He is a truly reliable teammate who brings great value to any project.

gates.text: Mathias brings an impressive combination of technical precision, logical thinking, and the ability to get things done. In our shared project at the Developer Akademie, he tackled challenging features independently and with a clean approach, while placing great importance on maintainable code. His quick grasp of new concepts and his solution-oriented mindset make him a developer you can rely on one hundred percent.

zuckerberg.text: I worked with Mathias on our bootcamp project 'Join'. From the very start, the collaboration was straightforward, reliable, and pleasant. I especially appreciate his careful, detail-oriented way of working. He actively contributes to the team, thinks along with everyone, and is someone you can always count on.

newell.text: I greatly valued working with Mathias Mayer on our shared project. He consistently stood out for his reliable way of working and made a significant contribution to our team's success. I can wholeheartedly recommend him as a technically competent and always collegial partner.
